tha-ap102:1.1: Buddhūpaṭṭhāka.] Vipassino bhagavato ahosiṃ saṅkhadhamako / niccupaṭṭhānayutto 'mhi *sugatassa mahesino* // //
tha-ap102:2.1: Upaṭṭhānaphalaṃ passa lokanāthassa tādino: / saṭṭhituriyasahassāni parivārenti maṃ sadā. // //
tha-ap102:3.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ upaṭṭhiṃ mahāisiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi upaṭṭhānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap102:4.1: *Catunavute ito kappe Mahā*nigghosanāmakā / soḷasāsiṃsu rājāno cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap102:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap102:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Buddhūpaṭṭhāko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
tha-ap102:9.1: Sudhāpiṇḍañ ca Celañ ca Kammāro Gandhamāliyo Tipupphiyo Madhu Senā Veyyāvacco va Dhammako Samasaṭṭhiñ ca gāthāyo asmiṃ vagge pakiṭṭitā.
tha-ap102:11.1: Buddhavaggo hi paṭhamo Sīhāsanī Subhūti ca Kuṇḍa-Dhāno Upālī ca Vījanī Sakacittanī
tha-ap102:12.1: Nāgasamālo Timiraṃ Sudhāvaggena tedasā catuddasasatā gāthā pañcapaññāsa-m-eva ca.
